root_cause.text: The rkcif driver did not set the `MEDIA_PAD_FL_MUST_CONNECT` flag on its sink pads, allowing stream enabling without verifying that a source entity is connected, leading to a null pointer dereference when `rkcif_interface_enable_streams` accesses an unconnected pad.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `MEDIA_PAD_FL_MUST_CONNECT` to both `pads[RKCIF_IF_PAD_SINK].flags` (in `rkcif-interface.c`) and `stream->pad.flags` (in `rkcif-stream.c`), with the commit message stating "The pads missed checks for connected devices which may a null dereference when the stream is enabled", and the crash trace shows a null dereference in `rkcif_interface_enable_streams`.
